news.title: Introducing Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
news.summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled Gemini 3.8 Live, a live AI assistant featuring a real‑time avatar that can answer queries and perform tasks within the Google Workspace environment. This new capability will be integrated into the Google Workspace Admin Console, allowing administrators to interact with AI via a conversational interface.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Immediately log into the Google Workspace Admin Console and navigate to the AI Assistant section to enable Gemini 3.8 Live for your tenant. S2: Failing to adopt this feature means missing out on automated ticket triage, policy drafting, and real‑time assistance for end‑users, which can increase response times and support costs. S3: This directly impacts your Google Workspace, JumpCloud, and Freshservice workflows by providing a single point of contact for policy management, user onboarding, and incident handling.

news.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
news.summary_raw: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.
news.summary: Modal Labs, an AI inference provider, is nearing a $750M funding round that would boost its valuation to $15.75B, more than tripling the company’s value in just four months.

A delay in evaluating this provider could mean missing out on cost-effective, scalable inference solutions that integrate with your existing MDM and SSO environments. news.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
news.summary_raw: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.
news.summary: AMD has announced a $8.2 billion acquisition of Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs, bringing her team into AMD’s AI research arm as executive vice president and chief scientist. The move signals AMD’s intent to deepen its AI chip and software ecosystem, potentially accelerating the integration of advanced AI models into hardware and cloud platforms.
news.enterprise_use: Check AMD’s AI platform roadmap and any upcoming updates to its ROCm SDK this week to align your GPU workloads with potential new AI capabilities. Inaction could mean missing early optimization opportunities for your Google Workspace or JumpCloud workloads that rely on AI inference. This acquisition most directly affects your AWS and Azure integration points where AMD chips may soon dominate AI compute workloads.

news.title: Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics
news.summary_raw:
Robots are getting smarter, but how can their hardware match that growth? New Microsoft Research findings show that moving AI inference beyond the robot can improve task success, boost efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads.
The post Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has demonstrated that offloading AI inference from robot hardware to external compute resources can increase task success rates and efficiency for physical AI workloads.
news.enterprise_use:
1. Review your existing robotics or IoT deployments to see if you can shift inference workloads to cloud or edge servers this week.
2. Failing to do so could leave your devices bottlenecked, reducing uptime and limiting feature rollout.
3. This is most relevant to any MDM or endpoint security tooling that manages device compute limits, such as CrowdStrike or Azure Arc.

news.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
news.summary_raw: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.
news.summary: Shopify has introduced WebMCP support for its checkout, enabling browser-based AI agents to modify order details and complete purchases with buyer authorization. This expands the platform’s AI integration capabilities, allowing merchants to automate more aspects of the checkout process.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Review Shopify’s WebMCP API documentation this week and test the new checkout AI agent integration in a sandbox environment. S2: Failing to adopt this feature could leave your e-commerce operations lagging behind competitors who use AI to streamline checkout, potentially increasing cart abandonment. S3: This directly impacts your Shopify store management and any third‑party tools you use for order processing and fraud detection.

news.summary: OpenAI has officially launched GPT‑6 Astra, a model it claims may be the first step toward artificial general intelligence. news.enterprise_use: Go to the OpenAI dashboard this week and add GPT‑6 Astra to your testing pool; the new model can dramatically reduce the time required for complex data analysis and report generation in your IT workflows. news.title: Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera
news.summary_raw:
Custom-made molecules are advancing medicine, materials, and agriculture, but producing them is slow and expensive. A new Nature paper highlights RetroChimera, a predictive model that helps accelerate chemical synthesis, helping researchers explore a wide range of molecules.
The post Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera appeared first on Microsoft Research.
news.summary: Microsoft Research has introduced RetroChimera, a predictive model that accelerates small-molecule synthesis by forecasting feasible synthetic routes at scale. The study, published in Nature, demonstrates a significant reduction in time and cost for drug, material, and agricultural compound development.
news.enterprise_use: S1: Monitor the RetroChimera API and data sets for potential integration into your internal chemical informatics tools. S2: Leveraging this model could streamline R&D workflows and reduce reliance on external synthesis services, freeing IT resources for other critical tasks.

news.title: Holo4: powering generalist computer-use agents
news.summary: Hugging Face has unveiled Holo4, a generalist computer-use agent that can navigate multiple software interfaces to perform complex tasks autonomously. The agent leverages large language models and multimodal capabilities to interact with common desktop applications without custom scripting.
news.enterprise_use: Monitor Holo4’s API integration for future automation of repetitive administrative tasks. Evaluate its potential to reduce manual workload in the IT helpdesk, especially for ticket triage and standard configuration scripts.

news.summary: Hugging Face has released a new vision‑language model called LFM2.5‑VL‑DSpark, designed to accelerate training and inference of multimodal tasks. The update introduces optimizations that reduce GPU memory usage and improve throughput on standard hardware.
news.enterprise_use: Review the new model as a potential replacement for existing multimodal inference pipelines in your IT operations. Evaluate whether the reduced memory footprint could lower cloud compute costs for your internal analytics or monitoring tools.

news.title: How to Use NVIDIA Warp and MjWarp to Accelerate Robotics Simulation and Learning Workflows
news.summary: NVIDIA’s Warp and Hugging Face’s MjWarp have been released to accelerate robotics simulation and learning workflows, combining GPU-optimized physics engines with open-source reinforcement learning tools. This allows developers to run complex simulations faster and integrate them directly into AI training pipelines.
news.enterprise_use: Check if your infrastructure can host GPU‑accelerated containers for NVIDIA Warp. Integrating Warp with your existing ML pipelines could cut simulation time, but requires GPU resources and compatibility with your current CI/CD and security controls.
